claim: In the final roll-call vote on Friday 27 November 2026, the Bundestag passes the 2027 federal budget (Haushaltsgesetz 2027) with at least 316 yes votes, an absolute majority of its 630 members.

runs.yes_requires: The Bundestag must pass the Haushaltsgesetz 2027 (Drucksachen 21/7300 and 21/7302) in a final third-reading roll-call vote within the stated Europe/Berlin window on 27 November 2026, with at least 316 yes votes.

runs.yes_requires: The Bundestag holds the final (third-reading) roll-call vote on the Haushaltsgesetz 2027 (Drucksachen 21/7300, 21/7302) on Friday, 27 November 2026 (Europe/Berlin), and at least 316 members vote yes according to the result announced in the chamber.
runs.decided_by: The official result announced in the Bundestag chamber, as recorded on bundestag.de (roll-call page or Textarchiv), in the Plenarprotokoll, or reported that day by dpa, ZDF, tagesschau, or Reuters.

runs.scenario: Same-day listed sources disagree on the yes count around the threshold—for example dpa or tagesschau reports 316 while Reuters or the bundestag.de/chamber figure shows 315—and one reader treats any listed source as enough for YES while the other treats the chamber announcement or official result as controlling and resolves NO.
runs.yes_requires: On Friday 27 November 2026 (Europe/Berlin), the Bundestag holds the final third-reading roll-call vote (namentliche Schlussabstimmung) on the Haushaltsgesetz 2027 (Drucksachen 21/7300, 21/7302) and at least 316 members vote yes.
